name: print-social-halftone-pixelated-chess-knight-in-slatted-light
title: Wooden chess knight pixelated into a mosaic grid, lit by slatted light and shadow on a dark board
whatItIs: A dark low-key photo of a wooden chess knight on a surface crossed by diagonal light stripes and a long shadow, with a fine square pixel mosaic laid over the whole picture.
whatItMeans: Strategic and moody; the pixel grid makes an analogue object feel digital.
techniques: Overlay a fine square mosaic on a photo.
Keep the subject warm against black.

vocabulary.definition: A fine grid of squares over an image.
Light passing through blinds forming stripes.
An object standing for an idea like strategy.
